overview: Vellamo Retail Group is implementing an AWS-managed integration hub to replace 31 legacy point-to-point interfaces connecting SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce Service Cloud, Shopify Plus, Nordkap Logistics (3PL), and Snowflake. The platform provides event-driven and scheduled data integration with retry mechanisms, sequence-gap detection, and daily three-way order reconciliation before the 2026 peak season.
business_problem: Vellamo Retail Group suffers from overselling and manual order cancellations caused by stale inventory data across systems and unowned legacy shell scripts. Furthermore, order status inconsistency between 3PL dispatch files and customer service tools increases handle times and operational complexity.

objectives.text: Replace 31 point-to-point integrations with a managed integration hub.
Reduce overselling and manual order cancellations by improving inventory accuracy.

user_journeys.validation_reason: Workflow derived from functional requirements and system integration points.
user_journeys.name: Order Placement and Status Synchronization
steps: Customer submits an order on the Shopify Plus storefront.
Integration hub calculates available-to-promise stock and reserves inventory.
Integration hub transmits order details to SAP S/4HANA for order creation.
Nordkap Logistics dispatches the shipment and uploads tracking confirmation files.
Integration hub updates Salesforce Service Cloud with real-time order status.

user_journeys.validation_reason: Workflow derived from file ingestion and validation requirements.
user_journeys.name: 3PL File Ingestion and Quality Validation
steps: Nordkap Logistics places dispatch and tracking files on the designated SFTP server.
Integration hub fetches files according to the drop schedule.
System performs duplicate detection on ingested file payloads.
System checks sequence numbers for missing gaps in sequence.
Operators receive alerts if sequence gaps or duplicates are detected.

user_journeys.validation_reason: Workflow derived from operator observability requirements.
user_journeys.name: Interface Error Monitoring and Replay
steps: An interface error occurs during message payload delivery.
Integration hub performs retries with backoff strategies.
Unresolvable messages are moved to the dead-letter destination.
Operator accesses the interface monitoring dashboard to review failures.
Operator selects failed messages and triggers a manual replay.

user_journeys.validation_reason: Workflow derived from returns processing requirements.
user_journeys.name: Automated Returns Processing
steps: Customer service agent authorizes a return request in Salesforce Service Cloud.
Integration hub routes return authorization details to Nordkap Logistics.
Nordkap Logistics processes returned goods and drops confirmation files.
Integration hub updates SAP S/4HANA with inventory receipt and credit status.
Salesforce Service Cloud updates the customer record with return completion.

user_journeys.validation_reason: Workflow derived from automated reconciliation requirements.
user_journeys.name: Daily Three-Way Order Reconciliation
steps: Integration hub gathers daily order records from Shopify, SAP S/4HANA, and Nordkap Logistics.
System executes automated matching across order IDs, quantities, and statuses.
System flags discrepancies between order capture, ERP entry, and physical dispatch.
System generates a daily reconciliation break report.
Data & Analytics Manager reviews break reports for investigation.

functional_requirements.statement: Order status in Salesforce Service Cloud must match 3PL dispatch status.
acceptance_conditions: Salesforce order status updates automatically within 5 minutes of 3PL dispatch confirmation receipt.
Customer service agents view consistent status across Salesforce and 3PL feeds.

functional_requirements.statement: The integration hub must detect sequence number gaps in Nordkap dispatch and tracking files.
acceptance_conditions: An alert is generated immediately upon detecting a skipped sequence number in incoming 3PL files.
File processing logs record missing sequence IDs for audit.

functional_requirements.statement: The system must calculate available-to-promise (ATP) inventory by subtracting reserved stock.
acceptance_conditions: Calculated ATP subtracts unfulfilled reserved orders from total physical inventory.
Shopify storefront receives updated ATP values.

functional_requirements.statement: The system must automate the end-to-end returns process across Salesforce, 3PL, and SAP S/4HANA.
acceptance_conditions: Return authorizations in Salesforce automatically generate 3PL return notifications.
3PL receipt confirmations automatically trigger stock and credit postings in SAP S/4HANA.

functional_requirements.statement: An operator view must display failed interfaces and enable manual message replay.
acceptance_conditions: Operators can view all dead-letter messages with error details in a single dashboard.
Operators can select and resend failed messages directly from the interface.

functional_requirements.statement: The platform must execute daily three-way reconciliation between Shopify orders, SAP sales orders, and 3PL dispatches.
acceptance_conditions: Reconciliation runs daily and compares order records from Shopify, SAP, and Nordkap.
Discrepancies in quantities or order states are recorded automatically.

functional_requirements.statement: The platform must generate a daily break report from the three-way reconciliation process.
acceptance_conditions: A daily report listing all un-reconciled order records is generated.
The break report is accessible to designated business users.

functional_requirements.statement: File integrations must include automated duplicate detection.
acceptance_conditions: Duplicate file ingestions are identified and flagged before processing.
Duplicate records are prevented from causing double updates in downstream systems.

functional_requirements.statement: File integrations must include automated sequence-gap detection.
acceptance_conditions: Incoming files are evaluated against expected sequence identifiers.
Gaps in sequence numbering trigger immediate operator notifications.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Shopify inventory updates must eliminate stale data to prevent order overselling.
acceptance_conditions: Inventory changes in SAP or 3PL propagate to Shopify without stale lag exceeding 5 minutes.

non_functional_requirements.statement: The solution must support reducing customer service average handle time to under 5 minutes.
acceptance_conditions: Order status queries return consolidated data within 3 seconds in Salesforce.

non_functional_requirements.statement: End-to-end latency for order capture from Shopify to SAP S/4HANA must be under 2 minutes.
acceptance_conditions: 99% of Shopify orders arrive as valid sales orders in SAP S/4HANA within 120 seconds.

non_functional_requirements.statement: The platform must handle 11,000 orders daily and peak volumes of 68,000 orders on Black Friday.
acceptance_conditions: System operates without degradation during simulated peak tests of 68,000 orders per day.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Target refresh rate for inventory position updates must be under 5 minutes.
acceptance_conditions: Inventory updates are dispatched to Shopify and POS within 5 minutes of stock adjustments.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Product master loads must execute full nightly loads and delta updates during the day.
acceptance_conditions: Nightly full load processes all ~9,000 SKUs.
Intraday deltas reflect product changes within 15 minutes.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Every interface must implement automated retries with backoff handling.
acceptance_conditions: Failed interface deliveries retry automatically with exponential backoff before routing to DLQ.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Every interface must maintain a designated dead-letter destination for unhandled failures.
acceptance_conditions: Failed messages exceeding maximum retry thresholds are preserved intact in a dead-letter queue.

non_functional_requirements.statement: System infrastructure must be sized for Black Friday week with 6x normal volume capacity.
acceptance_conditions: Infrastructure auto-scales to sustain 6x baseline order processing throughput without error.

non_functional_requirements.statement: Integration monitoring metrics must feed the customer's existing Grafana instance where possible.
acceptance_conditions: Key operational metrics are exported to Grafana dashboards.

non_functional_requirements.statement: File-based 3PL integrations must be designed to allow eventual migration to API-based integration.
acceptance_conditions: Integration architecture abstracts file ingestion adapters from core processing logic.

integrations.text: Capture Shopify orders and submit them as sales orders into SAP S/4HANA via API.
Transmit batched order release files to Nordkap Logistics over SFTP.
Receive dispatch and tracking confirmation files from Nordkap Logistics via SFTP.
Publish near-real-time inventory position updates to Shopify Plus and the in-house POS system.
Transmit customer and order data nightly to the Snowflake data warehouse.
Provide an intraday order-events stream to Snowflake for operational reporting.
Synchronize product master data, including prices and tax classes, from SAP S/4HANA to Shopify and Salesforce.
Reconcile daily payment provider settlement files against Shopify orders and post entries to SAP S/4HANA.
